results.name: Average Selling Price (ASP) Growth %
results.formula: asp_current = rev_current / qty_current; asp_past = rev_past / qty_past; (asp_current - asp_past) / asp_past

results.name: Average Transaction Value (ATV) Growth %
results.formula: atv_current = rev_current / bills_current; atv_past = rev_past / bills_past; (atv_current - atv_past) / atv_past

results.name: Units Per Transaction (UPT) Growth %
results.formula: upt_current = qty_current / bills_current; upt_past = qty_past / bills_past; (upt_current - upt_past) / upt_past

results.name: At-Risk Revenue Concentration Delta
results.formula: share_current = declining_rev_current / total_rev_current; share_past = declining_rev_past / total_rev_past; share_current - share_past
